verdicts.reason: A is basically the square shrunk into a band across the middle of the tall canvas. There's dead blue space above the yellow bar and below the doctor, whose body ends in a hard straight edge in mid-canvas. The symptom list and the yellow call-to-action are too small to read, and there's a big empty gap under the headline. B actually rearranges the layout to read top to bottom, with a large headline, a readable list and a full-width call-to-action, but it has clear flaws. The '6' sits alone on its own line. The list wraps so that 'Sore throat Headache' runs together on one line. The doctor no longer runs off the canvas edge: his body is cut off with hard edges at the left and bottom, so he looks like a cropped box. The hashtag bar is inset instead of spanning the full width.
